text:
sarah: Heads-up — we're seeing a sustained p95 latency spike (~18:12 UTC) in eu-prod inference path. I'm putting a temporary hold on any releases scheduled in the next 3h. @ops-oncall please confirm and share any early findings.

deploybot: AUTOMATION: Release windows blocked for region=eu, queues affected: canary, regular. Applied hold_id=H-3512346000. Set soft blockers on queued releases.

ops-oncall: Confirmed. Observed backlog growth on redis-kr-lane and increased 5xxs from inference-proxy. Investigating root cause (KV writer + repo-worker GC spike signal). Can we avoid non-EU impact by region pinning?

mike: Agree — recommend aborting the EU canary for build 2026.3.8 and pin EU slots to v2026.3.7 until this stabilizes. If degradation persists, rollback plan ready.

leah: On it. Aborting canary now and drafting a soft rollback checklist. I'll update the rollout doc and notes.

emma: PM note — please loop in customer-success for impacted EU customers and prepare a short status blurb for #announcements-prod. Also flag this for the postmortem if it ties to yesterday's infra tweak.

raj: Ops, can you grab quick traces/flamegraphs? Example:
```kubectl -n infra logs -l app=inference-proxy --tail=200 | grep -E "ERROR|WARN" | head -n 100```
Sharing traces link once available.

ops-oncall: Running the log/trace dump now. Early trace shows KV-cache write contention + repo-worker GC pauses. Uploading traces: https://traces.internal/trace/xyz (internal)

sarah: Decision: hold releases for EU until 3512347200. Disable canaries in EU and pin EU release slots to v2026.3.7. Non-EU windows may proceed but flagged as "caution". @deploybot please apply pins and update rollout metadata.

deploybot: ACTION: Applied pins -> region=eu pinned_version=2026.3.7, canary=false, hold_until=3512347200. Notified queued PR owners and updated release queue states.

leah: Release doc updated: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/2026.3.8 — added hold rationale, rollback steps, contacts, and checklist for reschedule. Planning a staggered reschedule after ops all-clear.

mike: Re-eval cadence: check +10m and +30m. If KV writer fix doesn't clear backlog by +30m, prepare for soft rollback + scale-down.

ops-oncall: Status update: backlog draining after scaling repo-worker pool. p95 down from ~2.8s -> ~1.2s. Keeping hold until we see stable 5xx rate.

sarah: Good progress. I'll post a short blurb to #announcements-prod and schedule a follow-up at 3512347200. Thanks all :heart:

deploybot: REMINDER: queued release 9876 moved to slot_resync at 3512347800 per hold policy. Owners notified.
